recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with feathered dark hair, wearing a light blue suit and black collared shirt, set against a backdrop of deep red velvet curtains. The lighting is warm and soft, characteristic of 1970s film photography, with text clustered in the upper left corner using a bold, heavy slab-serif typeface.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Text is anchored to the top-left corner over the background
Warm red background contrasts with the cool blue of the jacket
High-contrast black shirt provides a central visual anchor
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly off-center to the right, scaled to a medium-close portrait from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark black shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves to the bold white text in the top left, then down through the yellow sub-text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is utilized for typographic elements against the curtain texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and mahogany (background curtains and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with a warm, yellow-tinted white point, typical of aged print.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors
Limit to earthy, warm tones and muted pastels

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs with slight rounding
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dots on 'i' and 'j' are large and circular
Serifs on 'T' and 'h' are prominent and flat
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights, widths, and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy, friendly 70s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style studio portrait of a man with feathered hair wearing a light blue leisure suit and black shirt. The background should be out-of-focus red velvet curtains. Use warm film lighting with a slight yellow cast and visible grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, rounded slab-serif font in the top-left corner. The main title should be off-white and large. Sub-text should be stacked below in a golden yellow, slightly more condensed version of the same font.

verificationChecks: Is the font heavy enough to match Cooper Black style?
Is the color palette restricted to warm reds, yellows, and light blues?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?
Does the image have a soft, film-like texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any specific song titles or brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography is not overlapping the subject's face
Check that the red curtains have a soft, velvet texture
Verify the suit has a visible 70s-style weave or texture
Confirm the yellow text is legible against the red background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned 70s studio portrait with a top-left justified block of Cooper Black-style typography for an authentic vintage album aesthetic.
